QUOTE: `python/src/entropic/__init__.py` resolves binding names lazily (PEP 562 `__getattr__`), so `entropic install-engine` can run before the `.so` exists on disk.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that lazy resolution lets the package's install-engine subcommand run before the engine library is on disk, which is the substance of the item.
